description: Maps ast_dst's own concepts onto its schema (dogfood). Run from golang/: astdst --root . --config presets/self.json. Only two slots map to real structures: faults <- the Phase enum (the verification toolchain's SANY/TLC stages, where a drafted spec is found defective) and state <- the Model struct (the artifact the pipeline builds). operations/invariants/truths are honest gaps (an AST-walker has no weighted dispatch table or invariant catalogue); tla is disabled so it cannot reach the sibling docs/tla outside this tree.
